Package simple.file

Class FileUtils

java.lang.Object
simple.file.FileUtils
public final class FileUtils extends Object
Utility class for handling file operations such as creating, moving, renaming, deleting, reading, and writing files and directories.

Provides methods to perform various file manipulations and also parse and read file contents.

This class includes logging at various stages of the serialization and deserialization processes to help with error tracking and debugging.
